label: Ozone, daily 8-hour maximum
definition: Daily 8-hour maximum ozone (ppb) from EPA FAQSD, area-weighted over the residential buffer and averaged over the episode's days. (Result column: faqsd_o3.)

label: PM2.5, daily average (FAQSD)
definition: Daily 24-hour average PM2.5 (ug/m3) from EPA FAQSD, area-weighted over the residential buffer and averaged over the episode's days. (Result column: faqsd_pm25.)
